text:
Day 12 - August 2015 (age 12)

so this was I believe an art trade with an online friend! we gave each other elements to draw and I got fire ^^

now, you guys don't know how I dress but lets just say the fishnets were foreshadowing haha 

I think it's adorable to see younger-me drawing all these edgy outfits, never thinking I'd ever have the confidence to wear something that was seen as vile and horrid in my household growing up

It took a couple years and a move away from my parents, but we did get there, younger-me

thank you for drawing all these edgy designs, they were a great inspiration for your older self ♡
